create.name: Sara Clark
create.bio:
Sara Clark is a vinyasa yoga and meditation teacher who has been teaching for well over fifteen years. Her classes link flowing, breath-led movement with mindfulness, so that the physical practice works as a kind of moving meditation, and she leaves generous space for stillness and rest. Earlier in her career she was a lululemon yoga ambassador, appeared twice on the cover of Yoga Journal and taught for online platforms such as YogaGlo and Yoga Today, as well as on the faculty at Kripalu.

These days she works through private sessions, workshops and retreats, talks, and mindfulness programmes for companies, with a growing focus on supporting women through the passage into motherhood. Her guided meditation albums are available on Apple Music, and she writes Just Breathe, a weekly Substack of practices, rituals and personal reflections for mothers, sensitive people and spiritual seekers. Her YouTube channel holds full-length flow classes alongside a series of short breathing and meditation practices recorded with Shape magazine. On Insight Timer she shares guided meditations, breath-counting practices and yoga sessions that anyone can use for free.

flags: Thin listing: her site is a two-page brochure with no offering pages of its own (private sessions, retreats, speaking, corporate work and brand partnerships are listed but not bookable), so there are no offerings; items are YouTube videos plus the Insight Timer link and her Substack.
Mostly a vinyasa yoga and wellness presenter (brand partnerships, fitness media); the spiritual side is meditation, breath and her 'mother, mystic' Substack. A human may want to judge the fit.
Location unclear: Insight Timer says New York, but her Substack describes life on an island and her site names no base, so availability is set to worldwide with no city.
Email is a Gmail address published on her contact page.
The site photo (LalunaShoot_closeup) matches her Insight Timer and YouTube photos but carries no caption; fairly confident it is her.
Insight Timer bio: WebFetch quoted only the first sentence; the bio check relies on her own site and Substack pages.
left_out: No offerings: private sessions, workshops, retreats, corporate programmes and maternal wellbeing work have no pages of their own on her site.
YouTube 'Pranayama Meditation for Anxiety w/ Shape Magazine': condition-named.
Meditation albums on Apple Music: streaming albums, not a direct offering page.
Guest videos on other channels (YogaToday, Fuel Fit TV, a Portuguese chair-yoga upload): not her own channel or very short.
